item.title: Death Cab For Cutie Return To Indie Roots After 21 Years On Atlantic
item.description: In 2004, after the O.C.-abetted success of their 2003 album Transatlanticism, Death Cab For Cutie left the small independent record label Barsuk and signed to Atlantic, a major label. They've remained with Atlantic ever since, releasing six albums for the label, most recently 2022's quite strong Asphalt Meadows. item.title: Robbie Williams Breaks Beatles Chart Record By Waiting Out Taylor Swift Album Rollout
item.description: Robbie Williams now has the most UK #1 albums of all time. The former Take That member's latest, Britpop, debuted atop the UK album chart today, becoming his 16th #1. That surpasses the record of 15 set by the Beatles in 2000 with the release of their hits collection 1. According to The Guardian, Williams did it in 29 years, whereas the Beatles took 37 years to set the previous record.
